extend observed palette.\\n    # Fit a diagonal period and phase against every nonzero cell.\\n    best = None\\n    for p in range(1, min(n + m, 16) + 1):\\n        for sign in (1, -1):\\n            for phase in range(p):\\n                vals = {}\\n                ok = True\\n                for r in range(n):\\n                    for c in range(m):\\n                        v = grid[r][c]\\n                        if v:\\n                            k = (r + sign * c + phase) % p\\n                            if k in vals and vals[k] != v: ok = False\\n                            vals[k] = v\\n                if ok and vals:\\n                    # prefer a complete, smallest period that accounts for all colors\\n                    if best is None or p < best[0]: best = (p, sign, phase, vals)\\n    if best:\\n        p, sign, phase, vals = best\\n        cyc = [vals.get(k) for k in range(p)]\\n        known = [x for x in cyc if x is not None]\\n        if known:\\n            for k in range(p):\\n                if cyc[k] is None: cyc[k] = known[k % len(known)]\\n            return [[cyc[(r + sign*c + phase) % p] for c in range(m)] for r in range(n)]\\n    return [row[:] for row in grid]\\n''')\"",
